# T3 role choices

Read the shared [T3 target and permission rules](../../helix/references/t3.md).
T3 owns discovery and delegation; do not run the direct-CLI discovery helper or
maintain a separate model catalog.

Keep the current writer unless asked otherwise. Collect the provider instance,
then the model and its advertised effort options. Offer "provider default: T3
chooses; reported after dispatch" alongside literal models. A provider default
cannot resolve an explicitly requested effort without a model's descriptors.
Follow setup-helix's complete-catalog, missing-choice and preview rules.

For task-scoped choices, ask **Use / Cancel** and state that nothing is persisted.
Use **Save / Cancel** only for an authorized edit through an actual T3 settings
operation. Choosing roles does not switch the running writer or prove a save.

The inspected orchestration tools expose no persistent Helix-role settings API.
When none is available, provide per-task targets. Do not create a Helix config,
edit T3 databases, write native Codex/Claude role files as a substitute, or change
authentication, trust, permissions or provider adapters.

An authorized execution probe uses a fresh task. Report requested, observed and
unverified settings separately. A completed probe does not certify delivery or
review. Supervised children may need approval in their own threads.
